interpretation_limits: Isolated 2,111-neuron network (R1's); no other brain or cord input.
Reconstructed rate model (b from ratenet.js); 'active' (> 0.01 Hz) is permissive.
Drives above 2,000 lie outside anything the preprint's drive rule would select; they probe reachability, not physiology.
VNCSIZE inherits R1b's cable-length proxy for volume.
Descriptive: no controls, no rhythm verdict; the reported rhythm score is not a test.
Neural only: no body, physics or engine change; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
